supplements.title: Multiplex gene editing enables the multibiofortification of essential vitamins and other health-promoting phytonutrients in tomato.
supplements.summary: Scientists used gene editing to create tomatoes enriched with seven health-promoting nutrients that inhibited colorectal cancer cell growth in mice.

supplements.title: In silico and in vitro analysis: Unveiling the therapeutic potential of flavonoids against KLF7 in ovarian cancer.
supplements.summary: Flavonoids show promise as a potential treatment for ovarian cancer by targeting the KLF7 protein.

supplements.title: First evidence for isolation and characterization of Bacopa monnieri (L.) Wettst-derived nanovesicles with anti-neuroblastoma potential.
supplements.summary: Plant-derived nanovesicles from Bacopa monnieri effectively suppress neuroblastoma cell growth through free radical scavenging.

supplements.title: Nuclear OXCT1 attenuates histone β-hydroxybutyrylation-mediated MHC-I transcription.
supplements.summary: Nuclear OXCT1 suppresses immune genes in hepatocellular carcinoma, reducing immunotherapy effectiveness; blocking this pathway with ketogenic diet restores treatment response.

supplements.title: Gut microbial metabolites for potentiating cancer therapy.
supplements.summary: Boosting beneficial gut bacteria metabolites through prebiotics and probiotics may enhance cancer treatment effectiveness across multiple cancer types.

supplements.title: Gut microbiota and cancer immunotherapy: from dysbiosis to personalized immune checkpoint blockade optimization.
supplements.summary: Modifying gut bacteria through transplants or diet can improve cancer immunotherapy response by enhancing the immune system's tumor-fighting ability.

supplements.title: Modulation of brain antioxidant defense, inflammation, and SIRT1 activity by a sunflower oil-based high-fat diet: protective role of L-arginine in rats.
supplements.summary: L-arginine protects rat brains from oxidative stress and inflammation caused by high-fat sunflower oil diets by boosting SIRT1 activity.

supplements.title: Chemopreventive potential of quinones: Molecular targets and therapeutic potential.
supplements.summary: Plant-based quinone compounds show promise for cancer prevention and treatment through their antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and cancer-fighting properties.

supplements.title: Berberine impedes the DNA damage repair to inhibit colorectal cancer by regulating the SOX17/TCF4/PIM3 axis.
supplements.summary: Berberine stops colorectal cancer cells from repairing DNA damage through the SOX17/TCF4/PIM3 pathway, slowing tumor growth.

supplements.title: Very low-carbohydrate ketogenic diet in treatment-naïve women with endometrial cancer and overweight: a randomized feasibility study.
supplements.summary: A low-carbohydrate diet is feasible and well-tolerated in overweight women with endometrial cancer, boosting immune T-cells in tumors.

supplements.title: The Potential Protective Effects of Resveratrol Against Cabazitaxel-Induced Oxidative Stress and Cardiotoxicity in Rats.
supplements.summary: Resveratrol partially protects rat hearts from damage caused by cabazitaxel, a prostate cancer drug, by reducing oxidative stress.

supplements.title: Mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation inhibition by 9α,11α-dihydroxy-kaurenoic acid promotes ROS-associated apoptosis and suppresses cancer stemness in non-small cell lung cancer.
supplements.summary: A natural plant compound kills lung cancer cells by damaging mitochondria and reducing cancer stem cell properties.

supplements.title: Melatonin Alleviates Atrazine-Induced Kidney Damage by Regulating RIPK3 to Inhibit Necroptosis.
supplements.summary: Melatonin protects kidney cells from herbicide damage by blocking a cell death pathway controlled by the RIPK3 protein.

supplements.title: [Trends in smoking status and quit attempts among cigarette smokers].
supplements.summary: After heated tobacco products launched, cigarette-only smokers declined while combination use increased, and quit attempts rose but often switched to heated products rather than quitting entirely.

supplements.title: Sulforaphane attenuates oxidative stress and vascular remodeling in indium lung disease rats via mediating the NF-κB and Nrf2 pathways.
supplements.summary: Sulforaphane reduces lung injury and fibrosis in indium lung disease by activating Nrf2 and blocking NF-κB inflammation pathways.

off_label.title: Exploring Synergistic Potential of Sorafenib and Atorvastatin to Launch Apoptosis and Ferroptosis-driven Mixed Cell Death Mechanism in Colorectal Cancer.
off_label.summary: Combining sorafenib and atorvastatin triggers dual cell death in colorectal cancer cells, achieving 80% tumor reduction but requiring safer delivery methods.

off_label.title: Syrosingopine enhances immune checkpoint blockade efficacy by inhibition of MCTs and metabolic reprogramming in triple-negative breast cancer.
off_label.summary: Syrosingopine, a drug that blocks lactate transporters, enhances immune therapy effectiveness in triple-negative breast cancer by reducing tumor immunosuppression.

off_label.title: Dual targeting of glutamine metabolism and lysosomal function in eliminating drug-tolerant KRAS-mutant cancer cells.
off_label.summary: Combining glutamine and lysosome inhibitors eliminates drug-resistant KRAS-mutant pancreatic and lung cancer cells that survive initial treatment.

off_label.title: YK-4-250 mitigates gastrointestinal radiation syndrome and promotes overall survival following partial body radiation injury.
off_label.summary: YK-4-250 drug improves survival and gut function in mice exposed to lethal radiation doses by blocking harmful inflammatory signals and reducing oxidative damage.

off_label.title: AI-driven multi-omics drug repurposing nominates AZD7762 as a multitarget inhibitor of IL22RA1 and FAM221A in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma.
off_label.summary: AI analysis identified AZD7762 as a promising repurposed drug targeting two key genes that drive esophageal squamous cell carcinoma growth.

off_label.title: A sweet danger: the silent link between hyperinsulinemia and gastric cancer.
off_label.summary: High insulin levels increase gastric cancer risk and progression, but metformin treatment significantly reduces cancer recurrence and mortality.

off_label.title: Penfluridol directly targets PDPK1 to suppress AKT1 phosphorylation and stabilize CTR1, inducing cuproptosis in colorectal cancer.
off_label.summary: Penfluridol, an antipsychotic drug, kills colorectal cancer cells by blocking a protein that allows copper buildup inside tumor cells.

off_label.title: In silico discovery of novel small-molecule PD-L1 inhibitors through a multi-stage computational workflow integrating machine learning and molecular dynamics.
off_label.summary: Researchers used artificial intelligence and computer simulations to discover a new drug candidate that could block PD-L1 and treat cancer immunotherapy.

off_label.title: Identification of drug repurposing candidates for the treatment of polycystic kidney disease.
off_label.summary: Researchers identified existing drugs that could be repurposed to treat polycystic kidney disease, offering new treatment options for this serious condition.

off_label.title: Repurposing the Neurokinin-1 Receptor Antagonist Aprepitant to Eradicate Relapsed/Refractory Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia via Mitochondria-Driven Necroptosis.
off_label.summary: Aprepitant, an FDA-approved drug, kills drug-resistant acute lymphoblastic leukemia cells by triggering mitochondrial cell death.

off_label.title: Cilostazol inhibits TGF-α-induced migration of hepatocellular carcinoma cells by activating PPARγ.
off_label.summary: Cilostazol blocks hepatocellular carcinoma cell migration by activating PPARγ, which suppresses the AKT signaling pathway.

off_label.title: Metformin use and the risk of liver cancer in a Swedish population-based cohort study.
off_label.summary: Study examined whether metformin use reduces liver cancer risk in Swedish patients with both hepatocellular carcinoma and intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma.

off_label.title: Adverse events associated with statin co-use in breast cancer patients: a disproportionality analysis based on the FDA Adverse Event Reporting System.
off_label.summary: Statins used alongside breast cancer treatment may increase adverse events, requiring closer safety monitoring in these patients.

off_label.title: Modulation of Oxidative Stress and Nuclear Factor-κB- Associated Inflammatory Signaling by Rabeprazole in Acetic Acid-Induced Colonic Injury.
off_label.summary: Rabeprazole reduces inflammation and oxidative stress in colon injury models, potentially offering benefits beyond its acid-suppressing effects.

off_label.title: MEK inhibitor cobimetinib increases calreticulin and induces immune modulation in TNBC.
off_label.summary: Cobimetinib, a MEK inhibitor, triggers immune-activating cell death and boosts anti-tumor immunity in triple-negative breast cancer.

biomarkers.title: Mitophagy in cisplatin-induced kidney injury: regulatory mechanisms and therapeutic targets.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified mitophagy as a key mechanism in cisplatin chemotherapy's kidney damage, offering potential therapeutic targets.

biomarkers.title: NF1 and SPRED1/2 cooperate through RAS-MAPK-independent functions.
biomarkers.summary: NF1 and SPRED proteins work together to control cell growth through pathways independent of the RAS-MAPK mechanism in neurofibromatosis.

biomarkers.title: Multiplex gene editing enables the multibiofortification of essential vitamins and other health-promoting phytonutrients in tomato.
biomarkers.summary: Scientists used gene editing to create tomatoes enriched with seven health-promoting nutrients that inhibited colorectal cancer cell growth in mice.

biomarkers.title: Transition-state analysis of the arginine-specific human ADP-ribosyltransferase 1.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers mapped the molecular mechanism of hsART1 enzyme in lung cancer, enabling future development of targeted inhibitors to restore immune cell function.

biomarkers.title: Anti-CRISPR-mediated continuous directed evolution of CRISPR-Cas9 in human cells.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed CRISPR-MACE, a method to improve CRISPR-Cas9 directly in human cells, creating variants with enhanced resistance and altered DNA-binding capacity.

biomarkers.title: In silico and in vitro analysis: Unveiling the therapeutic potential of flavonoids against KLF7 in ovarian cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Flavonoids show promise as a potential treatment for ovarian cancer by targeting the KLF7 protein.

biomarkers.title: First evidence for isolation and characterization of Bacopa monnieri (L.) Wettst-derived nanovesicles with anti-neuroblastoma potential.
biomarkers.summary: Plant-derived nanovesicles from Bacopa monnieri effectively suppress neuroblastoma cell growth through free radical scavenging.

biomarkers.title: Nuclear OXCT1 attenuates histone β-hydroxybutyrylation-mediated MHC-I transcription.
biomarkers.summary: Nuclear OXCT1 suppresses immune genes in hepatocellular carcinoma, reducing immunotherapy effectiveness; blocking this pathway with ketogenic diet restores treatment response.

biomarkers.title: Open-channel block of human TRPV6 by polyamine spermine.
biomarkers.summary: Spermine blocks the TRPV6 calcium channel by binding inside its pore, revealing a potential target for treating diseases where this channel is overactive.

biomarkers.title: Inhibition of RNA polymerase II-activating CDK9 and CDK12/13, but not of cell cycle relevant CDKs, induces apoptosis by downregulating the short-lived Bcl-2 proteins Mcl1 and Bfl1/A1.
biomarkers.summary: Blocking CDK9 and CDK12/13 kills leukemia and lymphoma cells by reducing anti-apoptotic proteins Mcl1 and Bfl1, offering a promising new cancer treatment approach.

biomarkers.title: Autophagy-centered gene networks reveal prognostic biomarkers and therapeutic targets in esophageal cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified three autophagy genes (ATG4A, GABARAPL2, GAPDH) as prognostic markers and potential drug targets in esophageal cancer.

biomarkers.title: Exploring Synergistic Potential of Sorafenib and Atorvastatin to Launch Apoptosis and Ferroptosis-driven Mixed Cell Death Mechanism in Colorectal Cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Combining sorafenib and atorvastatin triggers dual cell death in colorectal cancer cells, achieving 80% tumor reduction but requiring safer delivery methods.

biomarkers.title: Targeting the miR-19b/PPP2R5E axis enhances temozolomide response in glioblastoma via ROS-induced DNA damage.
biomarkers.summary: Blocking a specific microRNA called miR-19b makes the glioblastoma drug temozolomide more effective by increasing DNA damage.

biomarkers.title: αKG-mediated carnitine synthesis drives DNA repair via histone acetylation.
biomarkers.summary: A metabolic pathway involving alpha-ketoglutarate and carnitine synthesis enables cancer cells to repair DNA damage through histone acetylation.

biomarkers.title: Risk factors for second primary cancer in patients who survive breast cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Older breast cancer survivors and those with high blood sugar or low income face increased risk of developing second primary cancers.

trials.title: Structured yoga program as supportive care to enhance quality of life in head and neck cancer patients undergoing radiotherapy: a prospective matched controlled study.
trials.summary: A structured yoga program improved quality of life in head and neck cancer patients undergoing radiotherapy.

trials.title: New paradigm in robotic partial nephrectomy: planned outpatient surgery in all patients.
trials.summary: Experienced surgeons can safely perform robotic kidney cancer surgery as planned outpatient procedures with same-day discharge in all patients.

trials.title: Inhibition of RNA polymerase II-activating CDK9 and CDK12/13, but not of cell cycle relevant CDKs, induces apoptosis by downregulating the short-lived Bcl-2 proteins Mcl1 and Bfl1/A1.
trials.summary: Blocking CDK9 and CDK12/13 kills leukemia and lymphoma cells by reducing anti-apoptotic proteins Mcl1 and Bfl1, offering a promising new cancer treatment approach.

trials.summary: Blocking a specific microRNA called miR-19b makes the glioblastoma drug temozolomide more effective by increasing DNA damage.

trials.summary: A metabolic pathway involving alpha-ketoglutarate and carnitine synthesis enables cancer cells to repair DNA damage through histone acetylation.

trials.summary: Older breast cancer survivors and those with high blood sugar or low income face increased risk of developing second primary cancers.

trials.title: Spatiotemporal mapping of CD112 unveils its dichotomous role in T-cell exhaustion and ferroptosis crosstalk in cervical cancer.
trials.summary: CD112 protein promotes immune evasion and drug resistance in cervical cancer; blocking it with PD-1 inhibitors enhances treatment effectiveness.

trials.title: Gut microbial metabolites for potentiating cancer therapy.
trials.summary: Boosting beneficial gut bacteria metabolites through prebiotics and probiotics may enhance cancer treatment effectiveness across multiple cancer types.

trials.title: Value-based pricing of tislelizumab plus chemotherapy versus chemotherapy alone for advanced oesophageal squamous cell carcinoma: a Markov modelling study from the US payer perspective.
trials.summary: Researchers determined the affordable price range for adding tislelizumab to chemotherapy for advanced esophageal cancer treatment.

trials.title: Early tumour size changes from neoadjuvant chemotherapy as a predictor of pathologic response in breast cancer.
trials.summary: Early tumor size reduction during chemotherapy predicts breast cancer response, but additional markers are needed for accurate assessment.

trials.title: Gut microbiota and cancer immunotherapy: from dysbiosis to personalized immune checkpoint blockade optimization.
trials.summary: Modifying gut bacteria through transplants or diet can improve cancer immunotherapy response by enhancing the immune system's tumor-fighting ability.

trials.title: Oxygen-generating Microparticles Enhance Viability and Functionality of Human Pluripotent Stem Cell-derived Cardiomyocytes for Myocardial Infarction Therapy.
trials.summary: Oxygen-generating microparticles improve survival and function of lab-grown heart cells for treating heart attacks.

trials.title: Early Tumor Shrinkage and Clinical Outcomes for Esophageal Squamous Cell Carcinoma Patients Treated with Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors: Real-World Observational Study.
trials.summary: Early tumor shrinkage predicts better survival outcomes in esophageal cancer patients treated with immune-boosting drugs.

trials.title: Linker Optimization in Lu-177 Labeled αvβ6-Integrin Binding Peptide Trimers for Targeted Radionuclide Therapy of Cancer.
trials.summary: Researchers optimized a cancer-targeting radioactive drug using PEG linkers to improve tumor uptake and retention for treating αvβ6-integrin-positive cancers.

trials.title: Membrane-Permeable Nucleoside T-1106 Diphosphate and Triphosphate Analogues as Antiviral Pronucleotides.
trials.summary: Modified nucleotide prodrugs improved antiviral activity against influenza and coronavirus by enabling efficient cellular delivery and activation.
